title: Wearable Robotics to Overcome Exercise Dose Limitations in Older Adults - Study 1
official: Wearable Robotics to Overcome Exercise Dose Limitations in Older Adults
summary: The purpose of this research study is to learn whether a lightweight wearable robotic device called We Innovate Mobility (WIM) can improve exercise capacity and physical function for older adults.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Community-dwelling adult aged ≥65 years
* Able to safely wear and use the WIM device
* Willing to complete conventional and WIM-assisted treadmill walking
* Able to provide informed consent and comply with study procedures
* Usual gait speed of 0.6-0.8 m/s

Exclusion Criteria:

* Recent hospitalization, surgery, fracture, or other medical condition that limits safe treadmill walking
* Resting blood pressure, heart rate, or symptoms that meet protocol-defined safety exclusion criteria before exercise
* Willing to complete conventional and WIM-assisted treadmill walking
* Requires a cane, walker, or other assistive device for ambulation
* Regular participation in structured aerobic exercise
* Any condition judged by the study clinician to make participation unsafe or interfere with study procedures
